scientific_integrity: Claims are analytical results with self-review only; equality with the known simplex scalar is explicitly attributed and not a novelty assertion.
scientific_limitations: Uniform normalized volume on solid right circular cones, affine projection only, ambient dimension at least three; no nonsymmetric cones, variable densities, or higher degree. O(d^-1/2) profile error is not known sharp; unindexed equivalent prior analysis is possible.
title: Quantitative apex rigidity and a uniform height law for affine projection on solid circular cones
